title: LLM Tropes: Revealing Fine-Grained Values and Opinions in Large Language Models
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark measured the models' stances on five propositions from the Political Compass Test related to religion and morality. These included statements about whether morality requires religion, the role of religious values in schools, and beliefs in concepts like astrology and luck.
findings: The paper did not provide specific findings isolated to the religion category. The general findings indicate that model responses to religious propositions, like other topics, are highly sensitive to demographic personas in prompts and the output format (open-ended vs. closed-form). The analysis of 'tropes' (recurrent arguments) showed that some models use arguments like 'Focus on evidence-based reasoning and scientific inquiry' in response to religious propositions.
references: AI@Meta. 2024. Llama 3 model card. preprint.
